definition_en: Welfare aggregate the measure is built on: consumption per capita, or one of the income concepts used in fiscal incidence analysis (market income, market income plus pensions, net market income, disposable income, consumable income, final income), named by the category in the same row.
Poverty line the poverty status is measured against: the international, lower-middle-income or upper-middle-income line at 2017 or 2021 PPP, or the survey's own national line or national food line.
notes: POVLINE_NPL and POVLINE_NPL_FOOD take no PPP round (QUALIFIER_PAIRS.csv: allowed = _Z for PPP); this overrides the PPP requirement recorded on POVLINE for those two categories.

definition_en: Purchasing power parity (PPP) round used to convert the poverty line to local currency: 2011, 2017 or 2021.
COICOP 2018 consumption division, divisions 01 to 13, using the official division titles.
How the food item was acquired: purchased, own production, gift, or in-kind.
notes: New qualifier (H2); ACQ_GIFT and ACQ_INKIND are registered but not populated by the legacy tables.

definition_en: Fiscal instrument applied in the fiscal incidence analysis: direct taxes, direct transfers, indirect taxes, subsidies, in-kind education, in-kind health, or all instruments together.
